messages:
tayler: Postmortem follow-ups for last week's outage — main asks: finalize auto-rollback playbook, set blast-radius caps for feature flags, and owners/timelines. Can we sync quick?
maria: +1. I've drafted a playbook in the doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/canary-auto-rollback. TL;DR — rely on latency/error budget + 2x spike in 5m -> rollback.
josh: Important: need a circuit-breaker at edge routing too. Also proposing automatic scale-back of rollout to 0% on error >=3% for 10m. Will own prototyping. ETA EOW.
kai: I can own infra changes (routing circuit breaker). Ping me with the rollout config. Also we should set safe defaults: e.g., 10% global cap, 1% per-account.
tayler: Proposed action items:
- Playbook PR (maria) — due 1924041600 (one week) [owner: maria]
- Canary config changes (josh) — due 1924185600 (two weeks) [owner: josh]
- Edge circuit-breaker (kai) — due 1924272000 (three weeks) [owner: kai]
- Monitoring dashboards + alert rule (sre-oncall) — due 1923995200 (in 5 days) [owner: sre-oncall]
Please add ticket numbers when opened.
maria: I'll open PR and add unit/integration tests. snippet:
```yaml
feature_flag:
  global_max_pct: 10
  per_account_max_pct: 1
  auto_rollback:
    error_threshold_pct: 3
    window_minutes: 10
    evaluation_signal: ["5xx_rate","p95_latency"]
```
deploy-bot: scheduled job created: canary-eval-runner cron @every 1m -> job id canary-eval-2026-03. Logs to #eng-monitoring.
sre-oncall: I'll add alert -> `alert: CanaryDeviationHigh` firing on evaluation signal + runbook link.
josh: Note: we should add a fallback to the previous stable route when rollback triggers (not just 0%). Routing policy needs a stable variant; I'll include that in the routing PR.
tayler: Great. Maria, can you also add a short smoke test that runs against staging after each canary increment?
maria: Yep, will include smoke tests in PR.
kai: Quick question — do we want automated rollback to be immediate, or staged with a paused state + manual approve? I vote immediate for safety-critical signals, otherwise paused.
tayler: Decision: immediate for safety-critical signals (5xx spike, auth failures), staged for non-critical regressions. Add that to playbook.
sre-oncall: Assigned alerts and created initial dashboard. Will share link in #eng-sre shortly.
maria: PR opened: https://redwood.internal/pulls/987. cc @josh @kai for reviews.
josh: Reviewing today.
tayler: OK closing thread — we'll check status next sync. :thumbsup:
